task: LLaVA-1.5 7B stage-2 full finetune (haotian-liu/LLaVA c121f0432da27facab705978f83c4ada465e46fd), 4 x H20

workload.upstream_recipe: scripts/v1_5/finetune.sh, unchanged except: 7B instead of 13B, 4 GPUs x per-device 16 x gradient accumulation 2 = global 128 (upstream: 8 x 16 x 1), --report_to none, local paths
workload.per_gpu_load: identical to upstream: 16 samples per micro-batch, model_max_length 2048, bf16 + tf32, DeepSpeed ZeRO-3 (scripts/zero3.json), flash-attention 2, gradient checkpointing
workload.sampler_note: LLaVATrainer groups megabatches by world_size * gradient_accumulation_steps = 8 * 16 = 128, so each micro-batch holds the same samples as one of upstream's 8 GPUs
workload.optimizer: AdamW lr 2e-5, cosine, warmup_ratio 0.03, weight decay 0, no gradient clipping

fixture.method:
Fixture for the LLaVA-1.5 finetune bench: a seeded random subset of llava_v1_5_mix665k.json and only the images it
needs, pulled out of the public image zips on hf-mirror by HTTP range requests (central directory + wanted members).

Sampling (seed 20261010): image-text samples uniformly at random from all 624,610 image samples (so the source mix
coco/gqa/ocr_vqa/textvqa/vg follows the 665k mix), text-only samples uniformly from the 40,688 ShareGPT samples.
  timing.json   18 x 128 image samples + 2 x 128 text samples (the sampler keeps one megabatch of each modality for
                the mixed tail, so the body is 17 image steps + 1 text step + the 2 mixed tail steps)
  case_mm.json  128 image samples (first 128 image samples of timing.json)  -> one optimizer step, image-text
  case_text.json 128 text samples (first 128 text samples of timing.json)   -> one optimizer step, text only
  probe.json    24 image + 8 text samples not in timing.json (held-out loss probe for trajectories)
